name: Gwyn Grosvenor
original_name: グウィン・グローベナー
source:
Serious and honest, he commands the Police Corps. He's the Empire's handsome prince, both refined and rugged!

He cares about his subjects, keeps up with new technology, and of course, won't accept bribes. Everyone has high hopes for this rising star.

[url=/c156154]Lady Scarlet[/url] has been giving him a hard time since they were students, but it looks like he finally lost his patience. Well, everyone probably saw that coming.
